description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Official issuer holdings for US spot Bitcoin, Ethereum and Litecoin ETFs (plus the Grayscale LTCN OTC trust, labeled as a trust not an ETF): ticker, product type, coins, shares, NAV, bought, sold, net change, AUM. Also all-fund totals, missing-fund notes, and related corporate holders (Strategy, Strive) clearly labeled as companies, not ETFs. Bought/sold is blank until two business days are saved. Filter asset=BTC|ETH|LTC or ticker. Returns JSON per fund (ticker, product type, coins, shares, NAV, bought, sold, net change, AUM) plus all-fund totals and missing-fund notes.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

asset.description: Optional underlying asset. Format: BTC, ETH, or LTC, as the tool text states. Example: BTC. Omit for all three.

ticker.description: Optional comma-separated fund tickers. Format: uppercase tickers. Example: IBIT,ETHA,LTCC. Omit for every fund.

name: etf_holdings
title: US spot BTC/ETH/LTC ETF coin holdings ($0.005)
